assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The symptoms are clinically consistent with the patient's known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is ordered to evaluate the suspected arrhythmic episodes
The CPT code for the ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is 93226
The diagnosis code I34.0 corresponds to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The payer denied CPT 93226 under reason code PR-204
Reason code PR-204 indicates the procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The appeal requests review of the denial determination against the documented clinical indication
